sign_in.title: Welcome back
sign_in.description: Sign in to your BNG Store account to continue where you left off.

sign_up.title: Create your account
sign_up.description: Register a new BNG Store account, then verify your email to sign in.

forgot_password.title: Reset access
forgot_password.description: Request a password reset email and continue recovery from your inbox.

reset_password.title: Choose a new password
reset_password.description: Use the token from your email to set a new password and return to sign in.
reset_password.missing_token: Missing reset token. Open the password reset link from your inbox.

verify_email.title: Confirm your inbox
verify_email.description: We're processing your email verification. This should only take a moment.

result.success: Your email address has been verified.
result.error: Unable to verify the email address.

store.title: Build your license
store.description: Pick the Craft apps you need or grab a bundle. Everything you buy is unlocked by your one license key.
store.catalog_unavailable: The store is unavailable right now. Please try again later.

suggestion.title_same_price: Get the {{bundle}} bundle for the same price
suggestion.description: The bundle covers everything you picked, plus more apps.
suggestion.description_with_extras: The bundle replaces some of your picks; {{extras}} stay as extras.

cart.title: Your license
cart.empty: Pick apps or a bundle to see the price.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: This is a test payment, so no money is charged. The order is held until {{expiresAt}}.

completed.title: You're all set
completed.new_key_description: Copy it now. For security we only show the full key once.
completed.existing_key_description: Your existing license key now unlocks the new apps.

account.title: My account
account.description: Your license key and the subscriptions it unlocks.
account.no_subscriptions: You don't have any subscriptions yet.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: One key unlocks every app in your active subscriptions.
license_key.none: You'll get your license key with your first purchase.

change_plan.title: Change plan
change_plan.description: Your current plan: {{plan}}. Pick the apps or bundle you want instead.
change_plan.new_period_notice: Your new plan starts today with a new billing period at the price shown.
change_plan.unchanged_notice: Change the apps or the billing period to continue.
change_plan.not_found: This subscription could not be found.
change_plan.not_adjustable: Only active monthly subscriptions can be changed.
change_plan.completed_description: Your license key now unlocks the apps in your new plan.
change_plan.yearly_notice: Your new plan starts today. Yearly plans can't be changed again until they end.

success.auth.sign_up.success: Please verify your email before signing in.
success.auth.forgot_password.success: If the account exists, a password reset email has been sent.
success.auth.verify_email.success: Your account has been verified. You can now sign in.
success.store.checkout.success: Order created. Complete the payment to activate your plan.
success.store.payment.success: Payment confirmed. Your plan is active.
success.store.subscription.cancel.success: Your subscription will end with the current billing period.
success.store.subscription.adjust.success: Plan change created. Complete the payment to apply it.

error.auth.sign_in.email_not_verified: Your email address is not verified yet. Check your inbox and verify your account before signing in.
error.store.selection.application_not_found: One of the selected applications is not available.
error.store.checkout.applications_already_owne: You already have some of these applications in an active subscription.
error.store.payment.order_not_pending: This order is no longer awaiting payment.
error.store.payment.order_expired: This order has expired. Please start the checkout again.
error.store.payment.applications_already_owned: You already have some of these applications in an active subscription. The order was cancelled.
error.store.payment.subscription_not_adjustabl: This subscription can no longer be changed. The order was cancelled.
error.store.subscription.not_adjustable: Only active monthly subscriptions can be changed.
error.store.subscription.not_cancellable: This subscription is already cancelled or has ended.
error.common.request_failed: The request could not be completed.
error.common.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
error.common.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
